map.两数之和/乘积最值演算器。输入和 S 或积 P，按实数/整数/正整数三种限制求最: A max/min calculator for sum and product. Enter sum S or product P, find the maximum product and minimum sum under real / integer / positive-integer constraints, give the optimal split and an enumeration comparison table, and verify any two numbers against the optimum.
map.：当 a + b = S 为定值时，ab ≤ (S/2)²，当且仅当 a = b: : when a + b = S is fixed, ab is less than or equal to (S/2) squared, equality holds if and only if a = b = S/2, maximum product = S squared / 4.
map.：当 ab = P（P > 0）为定值时，a + b ≥ 2√(ab) = 2√: : when ab = P (P greater than 0) is fixed, a + b is greater than or equal to 2 sqrt(ab) = 2 sqrt(P), equality holds if and only if a = b = sqrt(P), minimum sum = 2 sqrt(P).
map.：限定 a、b 为整数时取不到 S/2 的等号点，改取最接近的两数——和为 S: : when a and b are limited to integers, the equality point S/2 cannot be reached, instead take the two closest numbers: for sum S take floor(S/2) and ceil(S/2) (max product = floor(S/2) times ceil(S/2)); for product P take the factor pair closest to sqrt(P) (search downward from floor(sqrt(P)) for the first number that divides P).
map.：S < 0 时 (S/2)² 仍为最大积，最优拆分为两个负的相等数；P < 0: : when S is less than 0, (S/2) squared is still the maximum product, the optimal split is two equal negative numbers; when P is less than 0, one number is positive and the other negative, and the sum can be arbitrarily small (no lower bound), so fixed-product min-sum only has a solution when P greater than 0.

map.和定积最大：a + b = S 时 ab ≤ (S/2)²，等号在 a = b: Fixed sum max product: when a + b = S, ab is less than or equal to (S/2) squared, equality at a = b = S/2; integer-limited takes a = floor(S/2), b = ceil(S/2), max product = floor(S/2) times ceil(S/2). Fixed product min sum: when ab = P (P greater than 0), a + b is greater than or equal to 2 sqrt(P), equality at a = b = sqrt(P); integer-limited search downward from floor(sqrt(P)) for the first factor pair that divides P. The verification module uses |a minus b| to determine whether the two numbers have reached the equality point.
map.S=20 求最大积：实数解 a=b=10 → 10×10 = 100（上界 20: S=20 find max product: real solution a=b=10 gives 10 times 10 = 100 (upper bound 20 squared / 4 = 100); integer solution still 10 and 10, max product 100. Change S=21: real upper bound 21 squared / 4 = 110.25, integer solution can only take 10 and 11 gives 110, 0.25 less than the upper bound. P=50 find min sum: real lower bound 2 sqrt(50) is about 14.14, integer factor pair is 5 and 10 gives sum 15, 0.86 more than the lower bound. Substitute a=12, b=8 (sum 20, product 96) for verification: product 96 is less than 100, still 4 short of the max product, because |12 minus 8| = 4 is not equal to 0.
map.为什么限定整数解后最大积会变小？: Why does the max product decrease after limiting to integer solutions?
map.因为取等点 a = b = S/2 未必是整数。S 为偶数时 S/2 是整数，整: Because the equality point a = b = S/2 may not be an integer. When S is even, S/2 is an integer and the integer solution still reaches equality (e.g. S=20 gives 10 and 10); when S is odd, only the closest floor(S/2) and ceil(S/2) can be taken (e.g. S=21 gives 10 and 11), and the max product becomes floor(S/2) times ceil(S/2), 0.25 less than the real upper bound S squared / 4.
map.积为负数时为什么没有最小和？: Why is there no minimum sum when the product is negative?
map.ab = P < 0 表示两数一正一负。设 a 为很小的正数、b = P/a 为: ab = P less than 0 means one number is positive and the other negative. Let a be a very small positive number and b = P/a be a very large negative number; a + b can approach negative infinity, so the sum has no lower bound and no minimum. Similarly when P = 0, one of the numbers is 0 and the other can be arbitrary, so the sum also has no minimum.
map.枚举表里的高亮行怎么看？: How to read the highlighted row in the enumeration table?
map.「和定积最大」枚举表中高亮行就是最大积组合，可以看到积随两数靠近而单调增大，在: In the fixed-sum max-product enumeration table, the highlighted row is the max-product combination; you can see the product monotonically increases as the two numbers approach and peaks at floor(S/2). In the fixed-product min-sum enumeration table, the highlighted row is the min-sum combination; the closer the factor pair is to sqrt(P), the smaller the sum. This is the intuitive manifestation of the mean inequality a + b greater than or equal to 2 sqrt(ab).
map.「和定积最大」与「积定和最小」都要求两个数对称出现，取等条件均为 a = b: Both fixed-sum max-product and fixed-product min-sum require the two numbers to appear symmetrically, and the equality condition is a = b
map.限定整数解时取不到等号点，只能取最接近 ⌊S/2⌋ / ⌈S/2⌉ 的组合，最大: When limited to integer solutions the equality point cannot be reached; only the combination closest to floor(S/2) / ceil(S/2) can be taken, and the maximum is slightly less than S squared / 4
map.P 为负数时两数一正一负，和没有下界，因此「积定和最小」只在 P > 0 时有有: When P is negative, one number is positive and the other negative, and the sum has no lower bound, so fixed-product min-sum only has a finite solution when P greater than 0
